method: One fresh normal-production Chrome process per before/after study-500 diagnostic. 10 ordinary edits each; nearest-rank p95 is rank 10, equal to max. First certification sample is included. These two runs do not form a formal performance matrix.

config.processState: Fresh dedicated headless Chrome process and profile per case/run; HTTP cache disabled, OS caches not purged. macOS caffeinate prevents idle sleep only.
config.fixturePreparation: Unmodified original B5 strict-v2 packages; native production UI validates, migrates through v3/v4/v5 to strict v6, and saves an independent copy. Two small user layers are added through UI; only the independent marker is moved to C5 Focus, keeping all measured member transactions within 256.
config.localReopen: Manual recent-project open. Preparation removes only the optional localStorage sceneweave.outdoorSceneId hint, reloads the normal page, opens the recent-project details if needed and verifies the native repository is unchanged. The timed interval starts at the trusted recent-project button click; reload and preparation are excluded.
config.intent: Trusted capture of the committing click, Enter keydown, file change, selection pointerup, contextmenu or first continuous input. The tool observes DOM/events; it never wraps product functions, Canvas, React or storage.
config.domainCommit: Exact page performance.now captured by WorkspaceV6 after all domain validation, identity/freeze/undo updates and before publish. DOM data-transaction-revision must match the new data-revision. Import/open/name are separate operations and do not claim a domain edit commit.
config.completion: DOM revision, Canvas base render counter with map aria-busy=false, local-save status and double-rAF are separate observations. A retained preview raster can be reused on adoption. Double-rAF is a scheduling proxy, never GPU or physical display completion.

continuousInputs.pacing: One requestAnimationFrame awaited before every Playwright input; input timestamps, gaps, trusted event counts, view state and frame intervals retained. Wheel is continuous positive deltaY=12. Fit reset is outside each measured gesture.

networkAudit.policy: Retain every HTTP response URL/status, failed request, console error with source location and CDP browser log error. Only same-origin /favicon.ico with no query, status 404, no declared HTML icon, and a matching resource-load console/log source URL is incidental. All other HTTP errors and unexpected console/browser log errors fail the run. Canceled ERR_ABORTED requests are retained separately.

cpuProfile.boundary: CDP Profiler.start before the first ordinary-edit field fill/arm; stop after that sample has reached the same revision domain commit, DOM, Canvas ready, saved status and double-rAF proxy. Includes field preparation and automation/observer waits. Profile serialization is outside the sample; all profiled runs are diagnostic only.

limits: Original fixtures retain their original extent/grid; this runner does not claim a 50 by 50 displayed grid.
RSS is sampled macOS dedicated-process-tree sum and can double-count shared pages; JS heap is target CDP metrics, not GPU or total physical memory.
Tooling audit phases include package downloads, readonly IndexedDB hashing and output verification. Their peaks are separated from product phases; phase-boundary samples remain raw.
Real UI operations are automated headless Chrome observations, not human UX, cross-browser, VTT import, or a complete QA-PERF-04 pass.

Formal runs use no CPU profiling. Optional diagnostic profiling adds overhead and is restricted to the first ordinary-edit; no tracing, forced GC, heap snapshot or source/dev API. Observer, automation, frame and resource polling overhead are included.
A Node wall gap above 5 seconds or browser wall/monotonic discontinuity above 250 ms invalidates the run. Slow renderer samples are retained.

limitations: 高密度测量副本有大量真实尺寸物件相互覆盖，不是可玩地图布局或美术验收。
projectedPropCounts 是受众投影纳入数，propsWhollyInsideExport 是几何范围数；遮挡后的实际可见物件数未测。
源 PNG alpha 计数为实际文件像素；实例 alpha 面积按图像矩形缩放且重复计入交叠，不含阴影与合成后的可见覆盖。
rectangleGrid 以网格中心抽样旋转图像矩形，忽略源 alpha；不是精确并集，也不是内存或资源峰值。
保留原样板公开性；普通样板没有新增 GM 秘密，秘密差分回归另用 B4 配对夹具。
